title: Finding out that Pink was almost Hedwig on Broadway is actually blowi...
transcript: Could pink do Broadway next? This is a question I've seen be asked a lot after last night's Tony Awards, where pink not only hosted the show, but also performed a number from Chicago. And while this performance also made me very excited about the prospect of pink on Broadway, when asked about it on the red carpet, she didn't seem super enthusiastic about the idea. She did actually reveal that she has been offered Broadway before, specifically to be the first female Hedwig on Broadway. This would have been back in like 2014 2015 ish. And she did say that part of her regrets not doing it, but also acknowledged that the commitment of doing Broadway would be really difficult, especially as a mother and having to be away from her kids for eight shows a week. So while her official answer was never say never, I kind of got the sense that this wasn't something that she was super interested in. But I do imagine after the Tony's last night, she probably has a lot of casting directors hitting her up, especially Chicago if they haven't already. And it's a shame Moulin Rouge is closing, cause I also think that would be a great show for her. But at the end of the day, I think it's really gonna come down to does she wanna do it? Because she is a big enough name that if she wanted to do it, she could pretty much pick any Show and get cast in it
classificationReason: Discussion of Pink potentially doing Broadway following the Tony Awards — mentions Hedwig, Chicago, and Moulin Rouge but reviews none of them. No single production from the list is the focus, and no first-hand opinion on any production is offered.
